title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-04-28
content:
Release Engineering — Weekly Meeting Notes
Date: 2026-04-28
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT
Location: Zoom / #release-train Slack
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha Patel, Daniel Kim, Marta Lopez, Chen Wu, Samir Gupta, QA (Rita Morales)

Agenda:
- Quick status: current release train (v1.12.3)
- Hotfix review and retrospective (REL-340)
- Canary / rollout schedule for next week
- Changelog highlights and release notes prep
- Blockers & action items

1) Release train status (v1.12.3)
- Branch freeze scheduled: 2026-04-29 09:00 PT. Please avoid merging non-blocker PRs past this time.
- Target deploy to staging: 2026-04-30 02:00 PT; production canary: 2026-04-30 10:00 PT.
- Current merge queue: 18 PRs open (5 are infra / packaging related). Notable PRs: runtime perf kernel selection (#998), packaging/k8s manifests (#405).
- QA smoke tests: nightly run is currently unstable (see blockers).

2) Hotfix recap: REL-340 (regression in model routing cache)
- Incident: 2026-04-26 21:30 PT — customers observed increased 5xxs when a cached model variant was evicted and requested concurrently.
- Root cause: race in KV cache eviction + async routing; fix implemented in release/hotfix-rel-340 branch.
- Actions taken: emergency hotfix deployed 2026-04-27 00:45 PT to Dedicated and Hosted clusters; rollback plan prepared.
- Postmortem notes: quick fix reduced 5xxs by 98%, but introduced a small latency bump (median +12ms).
- Follow-ups: add deterministic concurrency test and tighten eviction-timeout metric alerts (see action items).

3) Canary / rollout plan for v1.12.3
- Canary group: 5% traffic to Hosted API region us-west-2 for 2 hours, then 20% for 3 hours, then full rollout if no regression.
- Metrics to watch: 5xx rate, P95 latency, token-per-request distribution, cost-per-token delta. Dashboards: /dashboards/release/v1.12.3 (Link in Confluence, posted in Slack).
- Fallback policy: automatic fallback to v1.12.2 if 5xx > 0.5% for 10 minutes or P95 increased > 20%. Ops on-call: Chen Wu.

4) Changelog & release notes items (high-level)
- runtime: improved kernel selection heuristics for transformer blocks (PR #998). Expected throughput +8% for long sequences.
- serving-runtime: fix for KV cache eviction race (hotfix REL-340).
- packaging: k8s manifest changes to pod anti-affinity for Dedicated (PR #405).
- console: added per-route rollout controls in the UI (feature branch).
- misc: dependency upgrades (openssl, ccache) and small doc updates.
- Notes: product comms draft needs examples and migration notes for Dedicated customers (P0).

5) Blockers & risks
- Nightly smoke job failures (CI/buildkite): flakes in smoke tests for model-startup timing. Assigned to Daniel to triage. Impact: could delay branch freeze if not resolved.
- Artifact signing: HSM key rotation scheduled for 2026-05-01 — need to confirm build pipeline won't be interrupted. Samir to coordinate with security.
- Capacity: Dedicated autoscaler had a hiccup last week; SRE investigating whether a scaling policy tweak is necessary for the canary window.

Decisions made
- Keep branch freeze as scheduled (2026-04-29) but allow patch-only merges for critical fixes with lead approval.
- Proceed with canary rollout plan above; extended monitoring period (extra 30 minutes at 20%) to be cautious after hotfix last week.

Action items (owner — due)
- Daniel Kim — investigate & fix nightly smoke-test flakes; report findings (2026-04-30).
- Samir Gupta — confirm artifact signing / HSM rotation impact on CI; update docs & pipeline (2026-04-30).
- Chen Wu — be on-call and monitor canary metrics during rollout; prepare rollback playbook (2026-04-30).
- Marta Lopez — finalize release notes draft and send to Product for review; include Dedicated migration notes (2026-04-29 EOD).
- Aisha Patel — add deterministic concurrency test to CI for KV cache eviction scenario; add alert for eviction-timeout metric (2026-05-04).

Open questions / parking lot
- Should we increase the canary size for Dedicated customers specifically? (need input from sales/CS)
- Follow-up: long-term fix for eviction race that avoids latency bump — schedule in tech debt board (REL-342).

Notes / references
- Incident ticket: JIRA REL-340 (link in linked_artifacts).
- Related PRs: runtime#998, release-engineering#412.
- Slack thread: #release-train (see linked_artifacts).

Next meeting: 2026-05-05 10:00 PT (normal weekly cadence)

Meeting adjourned: 10:45 PT

Notes prepared by: Aisha Patel
